items.q: Do you waterproof tin or GI sheet roofs?
items.a: No. We waterproof concrete — RCC terrace slabs, bathrooms, basements, and podiums. Tin, GI, CGI, and asbestos sheet roofs are a different trade. If your leak is on a pucca concrete terrace or through a bathroom slab, we can help.

items.q: What is retrofitting — and do I need it?
items.a: Retrofitting means making the columns and beams you already have stronger so they survive the next tremor. Guwahati is Zone V. Call us if a crack runs through a column, comes back after paint, or appeared after a tremor — not for a hairline crack in plaster between rooms.

items.q: Why test a building before buying or repairing?
items.a: Paint hides hollow or weak concrete. A building strength test is an X-ray for columns without breaking them open (NDT). Get it before you sign a resale deal, and before you spend on strengthening — so the repair matches the actual weakness. It is not a substitute for repair.

Depends on area, leak severity, and whether it is a concrete terrace, bathroom, or basement. A typical Guwahati RCC terrace starts around ₹80–150 per sq ft for proper membrane work — we quote after inspection, not over the phone. Free site visit first. Not for tin roofs.

items.q: How long does an inspection take?
items.a: Most home inspections take 45–90 minutes. We check the problem area, trace water paths or crack patterns, and explain findings in plain language. You get a clear recommendation — repair now, monitor, or no action needed.

items.q: Do you work during monsoon season?
items.a: Yes — monsoon is when most Guwahati homeowners notice leaks. Emergency leak-stopping (PU injection) can be done during rain. Full concrete-terrace waterproofing is usually scheduled between showers so the membrane bonds properly.
